It also markets sentance structure but I have yet to see it.

reviews.title: Great content but slow and clunky
reviews.text: I was excited to try this app after having used others (Speak, Jumpspeak, Praktika) but man-it’s just not usable as it is today. I don’t know what the issue is but this runs way too slow, as in it takes several seconds to “hear” and acknowledge my spoken response. And it frequently mishears my answer, like 50% of the time. Other apps I’ve tried have no such issues. It’s too bad because I do like the content and lesson plans, but I don’t have time to wrestle an unresponsive app.
